baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural أَكْوَابٌ and passive participle مَّوْضُوعَةٌ join drinking vessels to a completed act of deliberate placement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Handleless cups require direct bodily approach, while setting each object in a determined place removes fetching and preparation from the drinker's side. The line depicts readiness for use rather than a still-life inventory.

activation_trace.role: The handleless drinking-vessel image identifies an object meant for direct access and use.
Setting something down in its determined place supplies the completed preparation that makes the cups ready.

changed_reading.after: Handleless drinking vessels have already been stationed where use can begin without retrieval or further preparation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural vessel noun is qualified by a placement participle, allowing plurality to be read as a configured arrangement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The attachment image in ك و ب makes the many units compositional, and the assigned-place image in و ض ع gives each unit a station. Together they support a service array rather than an accidental heap.

activation_trace.role: Attaching one part upon another makes the vessel plurality available as a coordinated configuration.
Loads or persons assigned to a fixed place supply the functional image of each cup occupying a service station.

changed_reading.before: Several cups have been put somewhere.
changed_reading.after: The cups form a deliberately configured plurality in which placement assigns each vessel a role within an accessible array.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vessel root can foreground drinking as an act, while the placement root can carry the image of leaving a deposit with another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The objects are not only prepared but handed over: placement transfers drinking capacity into another's reach or keeping. Hospitality is therefore rendered as relinquished control over a usable provision.

activation_trace.role: Drinking by means of the cup turns the displayed noun toward the act it enables.
Depositing something with another recasts completed placement as a transfer of usable provision.

changed_reading.before: The cups belong to the decor of the scene.
changed_reading.after: The cups are provision deliberately relinquished into the beneficiary's reach, making hospitality a transfer rather than a display.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier drink scene couples being made to drink with a spring and a content that has reached an extreme state. Against that apparatus, the focus ayah relocates drinking into vessels already set down. The changed variable is agency: imposed intake from a source becomes unforced access to prepared portions.

activation_trace.role: Drinking from a cup anchors the revised model in the use latent in the focus object.
Completed placement makes the favorable drink available before any action is demanded of its recipient.
Giving someone drink supplies the contrasting causative relation in which intake is administered.
The flowing water source supplies an undivided origin from which the earlier recipients are made to drink.
Reaching full maturity or limit sharpens the source's extreme condition against the neutral readiness of the placed cups.

structural_cues: 88:4-5 forms a fire-to-administered-drink sequence, whereas 88:14 is a verbless display of already prepared objects.
The same ع ي ن source-slot recurs at 88:12 before the cups, allowing the two drink environments to be compared without equating them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administered drinking, a water source, extremity, cup-use, and completed placement; I infer that their opposed grammatical agencies are contrastive. A live alternative is that the scenes contrast only contents and outcomes, with no intended agency contrast.

changed_reading.before: The set cups merely add a pleasant counterpart to an earlier unpleasant drink.
changed_reading.after: The cups reverse the earlier drink mechanism: coercive delivery from an extreme source gives way to portioned drink made available without compulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A low-rank or humbling branch of the focus placement word is activated between persons in good condition and a high garden. The apparent contradiction resolves functionally: persons are elevated while service objects descend into reach. Lowness becomes accommodation rather than degradation.

activation_trace.role: The handleless vessel makes bodily reach especially relevant to where the object is lowered or placed.
Lowness of rank and humility supplies a social-vertical shadow to the cups' physical placement.
The face standing for the whole person identifies the beneficiaries whose position is being contrasted with the objects.
Good condition and beneficence supply the recipients' favorable estate.
Elevation of rank lets the garden's height operate socially as well as spatially.

structural_cues: 88:8 names the persons before 88:10 names the high setting and 88:14 names the placed service objects.
The passive participle leaves the placing agent unexpressed, foregrounding the completed accommodation rather than command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies favorable persons, elevation, handleless cups, and a lowness branch of placement; I infer a service relation in which objects are lowered so recipients need not lower themselves. The ordinary alternative is simple location with no social inversion.

changed_reading.before: Placed means only that the cups occupy a location.
changed_reading.after: Within a high estate, the cups' downward placement performs service: status rises for the persons while useful objects are made low and reachable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence around 88:14 moves from continuous flow to resting places raised, cups stationed, cushions aligned, and carpets dispersed. The cups become transfer nodes between a resource and bodies at rest; their placement mediates vertical elevation and horizontal distribution.

activation_trace.role: Cup-mediated drinking gives the central objects a transfer function rather than a merely decorative one.
Assignment to a determined station makes each cup a node in the surrounding arrangement.
Continuing provision or supply gives the upstream flow a sustaining function that the cups can portion.
A place of settled rest identifies the bodies and activity around which the service nodes are arranged.
Physical raising supplies the vertical coordinate immediately before the focus placement.
Alignment on an even line supplies ordered horizontal adjacency after the cups.
Dispersal supplies broad coverage, extending the local cup stations into a complete inhabited surface.

structural_cues: 88:12-16 is an uninterrupted sequence of source, resting furniture, cups, cushions, and floor coverings.
The four object lines 88:13-16 use parallel indefinite nouns followed by feminine passive participles.
The participles progress through raised, placed, aligned, and dispersed, giving placement a distinct middle operation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuous provision, rest, elevation, stationing, alignment, and dispersal; I infer a functional topology in which cups transfer flow to resting occupants. A live alternative is a noncausal catalogue whose spatial verbs signal abundance only.

changed_reading.before: The cups are one furnishing among several.
changed_reading.after: The cups are the middle transfer layer of an engineered hospitality field, connecting continuous supply to elevated rest and distributing access across the furnished surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later inspection sequence repeats made, raised, erected, and spread forms at world scale. Its measured vertical and horizontal operations reactivate the focus participle: setting cups is the domestic-scale member of the same grammar of assigning forms to useful positions.

activation_trace.role: Parts attached into a configuration let the cup plurality behave as a small constructed order.
Setting an object in a determined place anchors the domestic scene in the later sequence of world-shaping operations.
Measuring and proportioning supplies deliberate calibration rather than unexplained existence.
Raising establishes the cosmic vertical operation that echoes the raised furniture before the focus.
Erecting something visibly upright supplies fixed placement at monumental scale.
An extended level surface supplies the horizontal field on which smaller useful arrangements can be placed.

structural_cues: The branchless cue ك ي ف recurs at 88:17 word 5, 88:18 word 3, 88:19 word 3, and 88:20 word 3; it is used only as the repeated question-frame linking four operations.
The feminine passive sequence خُلِقَتْ, رُفِعَتْ, نُصِبَتْ, and سُطِحَتْ recalls the passive participial sequence surrounding مَّوْضُوعَةٌ.
The later sequence spans creature, sky, mountain, and earth, scaling placement from local furnishing to an inhabitable world.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated creation, vertical raising, erection, leveling, and repeated ك ي ف framing; I infer that the shared passive spatial grammar invites a microcosm-to-cosmos analogy. The alternative is purely rhetorical parallelism with no backward activation of the cups.

changed_reading.before: The cups are a localized luxury detail.
changed_reading.after: Their exact placement miniaturizes the later world-order: hospitality and habitat are made intelligible by the same measured allocation of forms to positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return to a place and reckoning-as-sufficiency pull the deposited-provision baseline toward destination logic. The cups read as an already credited sufficiency waiting at the terminus, not as a temporary amenity encountered en route.

activation_trace.role: The act of drinking identifies the concrete benefit made available at the destination.
A deposit left with another supplies the image of provision already lodged ahead of its beneficiary.
Return to a home or place supplies the terminal location toward which the prepared provision can be read.
Sufficiency and enrichment activate the cups as an adequate provision rather than an ornamental quantity.

structural_cues: 88:25-26 closes with parallel destination and responsibility constructions using إِلَيْنَا and عَلَيْنَا.
The possessive endings in إِيَابَهُمْ and حِسَابَهُم make return and account belong to the same persons for whom the earlier scene is furnished.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deposited object, return to a place, and a sufficiency branch within account; I infer that the prepared cups can be read prospectively as provision at the terminus. A live alternative is that return and account concern only judgment and do not reactivate furnishing.

changed_reading.before: The cups are amenities inside a static scene.
changed_reading.after: The cups are provision lodged at the destination in advance, making arrival a return to already sufficient hospitality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface plural ordinarily identifies drinking cups, while the cited ك و ب branch names a music instrument. It remains valid as a root-branch and sonic activation under the nearby negation of heard noise: an instrument-shadow can be imagined as laid down and inactive. Downstream prose must mark this as lexical resonance, never translate أَكْوَابٌ as instruments.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The instrument branch belongs to the focus root ك و ب, and the placement participle can materially render sonic potential as set down.

activation_trace.role: The drum or reed-instrument image supplies a latent sonic object behind the ordinary cup surface.
Setting the object down lets the activated instrument-shadow be physically stilled.
Pleasurable hearing and music make the absent sonic channel specific enough to activate the instrument branch.
Mixed noisy sound supplies what the scene excludes, turning set-down sonic objects into an image of tranquility.

changed_reading.before: The absence of idle sound and the presence of cups are unrelated comforts.
changed_reading.after: At the level of lexical shadow, even an instrument latent in the cup-root has been laid down: abundance remains, but clamor is disarmed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because a chessboard sense of ك و ب does not override the explicit cup form. It remains anchored as a configuration analogy: placed cups, aligned cushions, dispersed coverings, and later counting can make the furnished field resemble pieces distributed over a board. Downstream prose must present it only as a spatial activation, not as a claim that the ayah denotes a game.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The chess or board branch is internal to ك و ب, while مَّوْضُوعَةٌ explicitly makes disposition in space part of the focus line.

activation_trace.role: The chessboard or game-object image activates a field of discrete pieces and positions behind the vessel plurality.
Units assigned to fixed places make the cups behave visually like positioned pieces.
Straight alignment supplies one organizing rule for the surrounding field.
Distribution across space supplies the complementary rule of coverage rather than a single row.
Counting supplies a remote terminal echo of discrete, positionable units.

changed_reading.before: The furnishings form a static catalogue.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial analogy, the cups become positioned units in a legible field whose rows, spread, and count imply designed relational order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because thin-necked, large-headed morphology is a remote descriptive branch and cups are not persons. It remains materially anchored in the vessel silhouettes and in the focus root's own assigned-person branch, while faces and resting places provide nearby bodily cues. Downstream prose must qualify it as visual anthropomorphism, not lexical personification or doctrine.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cup root contains a thin-necked, large-headed profile, and the placement root contains persons assigned to positions.

activation_trace.role: A thin neck and enlarged head supply an anthropomorphic silhouette latent in the cup-root.
Persons assigned to a fixed place let the repeated vessel silhouettes be imagined as stationed bodies.
The face as a stand-in for the person supplies the nearby bodily scale for the visual analogy.
A resting or reclining place situates bodies near the stationed cup silhouettes.

changed_reading.before: The cups are inert objects beside human occupants.
changed_reading.after: As a visual-material outlier, their necked silhouettes and assigned stations echo the resting occupants, making service objects into quiet proxies for a fully populated scene.

strongest_changes: The earlier administered drink and the later set cups form an agency reversal from imposed intake to unforced availability.
The 88:12-16 furnishing chain turns the cups into transfer nodes between continuous supply, elevated rest, ordered adjacency, and broad coverage.
The 88:17-20 passive spatial sequence scales deliberate placement from domestic hospitality to an ordered inhabitable world.
A secondary vertical reading lets objects descend into reach while beneficiaries and setting remain elevated.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line's brevity concentrates several live functions in مَّوْضُوعَةٌ: readiness, assignment, lowering, deposit, and participation in a larger placement grammar. The sparse cup root then contributes unusually vivid shadows of attachment, instrument, board, and bodily profile without requiring any of them to replace the ordinary vessel reading.
remaining_uncertainties: It is uncertain whether the agency contrast between administered and offered drink is encoded by the sequence or supplied mainly by reader comparison.
The social lowering, destination-provision, instrument, board, and anthropomorphic readings depend on branch activation beyond the most immediate lexical senses.
The microcosm-to-cosmos relation may be a designed backward echo or only a shared passive descriptive style.
